cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my cup upside down like yours. Rainproof. Will you approve storing Tuesday's rain in it? We need a dry wedding lawn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm drying my cup. Tuesday hasn't happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dry vessel first, naturally. We'll catch the rain before it learns how to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I have another wedding Wednesday. What if it leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll seal it with Thursday's drought. Sign for two dry weddings; I'll invoice the drought after it happens.

reason: Copied drying position becomes impossible rain storage confidence; B timeline and leak questions each make proposed approval logic stranger.
